description: This file defines the IGrainRuntime interface in C#, which provides methods and properties for interacting with the Orleans runtime from a grain's perspective, including silo identification, storage, timers, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: IGrainRuntime
classes.description: Interface for the Orleans grain runtime gateway, enabling grains to interact with the Orleans runtime environment.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the specified grain when it becomes idle.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation of a grain due to inactivity for a specified timespan.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage associated with a specific grain context.
